item.title: YouTubePlus v21.40.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.40.5 | YouTubePlus_21.40.5_6.0b2
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
**Cracked by** [@itzzace](https://github.com/itzzace)
> [!NOTE] > - 🔑 No subscription required. > - ✅ New Downloads manager. > - 📺 Full 4KHDR support. YTUHD no longer needed. > - ⚠️Beta release, some features may still glitch. > - 📝 [6.0b2 release notes](https://github.com/dayanch96/YTLite/releases/tag/v6.0-b2) > - You can get local network access prompt from YTKace to enable casting in YTLite. just overwrite ytkace when done. > > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YTweaks` `Gonerino` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
